build_bm25_index: build a BM25 index from a corpus of tokenized documents with configurable k1 and b parameters
retrieve_top_n_documents: retrieve the top n most relevant documents for a tokenized query using BM25 scoring
save_bm25_index: save a BM25 index object to a pickle file for later reuse
load_bm25_index: load a previously saved BM25 index from a pickle file
review_bm25_class: review the BM25 class implementation including term frequency, IDF computation, and document scoring
